title: HR Coordinator
company: Michael Page Business Support - Agency - Permanent
description:
As an HR Coordinator in the healthcare industry based in Birmingham, you'll support the day-to-day operations of the Human Resources department, ensuring everything runs smoothly. This role involves handling administrative tasks, coordinating HR processes, and assisting in maintaining a positive and efficient workplace.

Client Details

A healthcare organisation based in Birmingham, our client is industry leading and now seeking a HR Coordinator to join their team on a 12 Month FTC.

Description
- Manage HR administration processes and maintain accurate employee records.
- Act as a first point of contact for HR-related queries, providing professional and confidential support.
- Coordinate end-to-end recruitment activities, including advertising vacancies, screening applications, arranging interviews, and supporting hiring managers.
- Prepare employment contracts, offer letters, and onboarding documentation.
- Support new starters throughout the onboarding and induction process.
- Monitor mandatory training, compliance requirements, right-to-work checks, DBS renewals, and workforce records.
- Maintain employee attendance and sickness absence records.
- Assist with employee relations processes, including note-taking and meeting administration.
- Coordinate training programmes, professional development activities, and compliance reporting.
- Produce HR and training reports to support managers and senior leaders.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives across the HR function.

Profile

A successful HR Coordinator should have:
- Experienced in an HR administration, HR coordination, or recruitment support role.
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Confident managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
- Comfortable working with HR systems and maintaining accurate records.
- A strong communicator with excellent interpersonal skills.
- Professional, discreet, and able to maintain confidentiality.
- Proactive, adaptable, and eager to learn and develop within HR.
- Competent in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and reporting tools.

Job Offer
- Salary ranging from £27,200 to £30,800, dependent on the level of experience.
- Fixed-term contract with potential for further opportunities.
- Valuable experience within the healthcare industry.
- Hybrid working
- Free parking on site

If you're interested in this HR Coordinator role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: In-House Recruiter (FTC)
description:
Helping others improve and turn their lives around - there's no better feeling. It's what we do for thousands of people at more than 150 sites across the UK. Be a part of it.

Are you an experienced in-house or agency Recruiter or Resourcer looking for your next opportunity?

Cygnet is looking for a motivated and organised Recruiter to join our friendly Recruitment Team for a 12 month maternity cover contract. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, sourcing talent, managing recruitment campaigns and delivering an exceptional candidate experience.

Working in a fast-paced environment, you'll play a key role in attracting and engaging candidates across our services, supporting managers to fill vacancies efficiently while ensuring a smooth and professional recruitment process from application through to offer.

This hybrid role offers the flexibility of three days working from home and two days in our Birmingham city centre office!

Why Join Cygnet?

At Cygnet, we invest in our people. You'll join a supportive and collaborative team where you'll gain valuable recruitment experience, work closely with operational leaders and HR professionals, and contribute directly to ensuring our services have access to the talent they need to deliver exceptional care.

Whether you're an experienced recruiter or looking to take the next step in your talent acquisition career, we'll provide the support, training and development to help you succeed.

The Role

As a Recrui
ter, you'll be responsible for managing recruitment activity across designated services, supporting hiring managers to attract and secure high-quality candidates.

You'll work closely with Service Managers, HR Business Partners and candidates to deliver an efficient recruitment service while maintaining high standards of customer service and candidate engagement.

This role would suit someone who enjoys:
- Building relationships with candidates and stakeholders
- Delivering excellent customer service
- Managing multiple vacancies and priorities
- Working towards recruitment targets
- Finding innovative ways to attract talent
- Working in a fast-paced, people-focused environment
- Supporting organisational growth through talent acquisition

Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities
- Manage recruitment activity across allocated services and vacancies
- Advertise vacancies across job boards, social media and other recruitment channels
- Proactively source candidates using a variety of recruitment methods
- Screen applications and CVs to identify suitable candidates
- Build and maintain candidate pipelines for current and future opportunities
- Liaise regularly with Service Managers and HR Business Partners to support recruitment objectives
- Provide regular updates on vacancy progress and recruitment performance
- Maintain accurate records and candidate information within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
- Respond promptly to candidate and stakeholder enquiries
- Support candidates throughout the recruitment process, ensuring a positive experience
- Provide interview and recruitment feedback where appropriate
- Attend recruitment events, careers fairs and service visits when required
- Work collaboratively with colleagues across Recruitment and HR to ensure recruitment targets are achieved

We're Looking For S
omeone Who
- Has previous experience in recruitment, resourcing, talent acquisition or recruitment administration
- Is highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Enjoys building relationships and delivering outstanding customer service
- Can manage multiple vacancies and competing priorities effectively
- Is confident communicating with stakeholders at all levels
- Demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills
- Can work independently while contributing positively to a team environment
- Has strong administrative and organisational skills
- Is resilient and able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment
- Has experience using recruitment systems or applicant tracking systems

Desirable but Not Essential
- Previous in-house or agency recruitment experience
- Experience recruiting within healthcare, social care or regulated sectors
- Experience using social media and proactive sourcing techniques
- Experience attending recruitment events and careers fairs

What We'll Offer You
- Hybrid working: three days from home and two days in Birmingham city centre
- Discretionary annual 20% bonus, paid quarterly
- Excellent career development opportunities within Recruitment, Talent Acquisition and HR
- Expert supervision and support
- Health Cash Plan
- 24/7 GP support line
- Free life assurance cover
- Free eye tests
- Employee discounts and savings schemes
- Car lease discounts
- Discounted gym membership
- Free mortgage broker and insurance support
- Cycle to Work scheme
- Pension scheme
- Smart Health Toolkit including fitness programmes, nutrition consultations and health checks

About Cygnet

Cygnet has been providing high-quality specialist mental health services across the UK for more than 30 years. Every day,
our teams make a difference to the lives of the people in our care, their families and communities.

As a Recruiter, you'll play a vital role in helping us attract and engage the talented individuals who deliver exceptional care across our services.

Ready to Join Our Recruitment Team?

If you're an experienced recruiter, recruitment coordinator, resourcer or talent professional looking for your next challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and join a team where your communication skills, organisational ability and passion for people can make a real impact.

Important Information

Successful candidates will be required to undergo an Enhanced DBS check.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early should we receive a high volume of suitable applications.

Interviews are provisionally scheduled to take place on Wednesday 26th August.

What next?

If you care about making a difference - we want to talk to you.

title: People & Recruitment Coordinator
company: ADI Group Services Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
People & Recruitment Coordinator

Location: Kings Norton, Birmingham

About the Role

We're looking for a People & Recruitment Coordinator to join our Group HR team and support both recruitment and day-to-day HR administration across adi Group.

Around 40-50% of the role will focus on recruitment, including sourcing candidates, screening applications, carrying out initial telephone calls, coordinating interviews, managing candidate communication and maintaining recruitment systems and pipelines.

You'll work closely with our People & Talent Advisor, supporting recruitment across a range of specialist and technical roles.

The rest of the role will focus on practical HR administration, including new starters, onboarding, induction, HR systems, employee records, benefits, training, employee changes, leavers and general HR support.

This role would suit someone who enjoys a varied, hands-on coordination role, likes keeping processes organised and accurate, and is happy supporting a busy HR team.

Key Responsibilities
- Support recruitment activity across the Group, from vacancy advertising through to interview coordination and candidate management.
- Proactively source candidates using LinkedIn, job boards and recruitment databases.
- Review CVs and applications and carry out initial screening calls.
- Maintain candidate pipelines and recruitment records.
- Coordinate interviews and maintain regular communication with candidates and hiring managers.
- Support with recruitment reporting and system administration.
- Prepare offer letters, contracts and new starter documentation.
- Support onboarding and induction activity.
- Set up new starters on HR systems and relevant platforms.
- Support with Human Focus, Drive IQ and other employee system administration.
- Maintain accurate employee records and documentation.
- Support with employee changes and standard HR administration.
- Support with benefits portal administration.
- Support with leaver and offboarding administration.
- Support apprenticeship recruitment and Apprenticeship Academy activity.
- Support the Responsible Business programme and associated activity.
- Assist the People & Talent Advisor and Group HR Director with people projects and process improvements.
- Provide a professional, responsive and confidential service to candidates, employees and managers.

About You

We would like to hear from you if you have:
- Some previous experience in recruitment, HR administration or a people-focused role.
- A good understanding of the recruitment process.
- Strong organisation and attention to detail.
- Confidence dealing with candidates, employees and managers.
- Good communication and people skills.
- Confidence using Microsoft Office, recruitment platforms and HR systems.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
- A professional approach to confidential information.
- A reliable, consistent and methodical approach to work.
- An interest in a varied coordination role with a strong mix of recruitment and HR administration.

The Benefits
- The adi Pit Stop - savings and discounts portal with Reward Gateway
- Healthcare cash plan
- 24/7 GP helpline including private electronic prescription service
- Enhanced Employee Assistance Programme
- Cycle to work scheme
- Employee referral bonus of £500 for every successful new employee
- Generous holiday allowance
- Celebration days
- Company-wide Christmas party for employees and partners
- Annual employee awards
- Long service awards
- Free workwear

The Company

Find out more about adi at:

Other organisations may call this role a Recruitment & HR Coordinator, People Services Coordinator, Talent Acquisition Coordinator or Recruitment & Resourcing Coordinator.

adi Group is fully committed to the principle of equal opportunity in employment and seeks to ensure that the careers of all employees are determined solely on merit and opportunity and that judgement of employees is free from the effects of bias and prejudice.

title: Recruitment Administrator - Healthcare Recruitment
company: Brookes HC Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Recruitment Administrator

Brookes HC Recruitment Ltd is looking for an organised and experienced Recruitment Administrator to join our busy healthcare recruitment team.

The successful candidate must have a good understanding of recruitment compliance and ideally have previous experience within healthcare, social care or temporary recruitment.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing candidate registrations and onboarding
- Ensuring candidate files are fully compliant before workers are cleared for work
- Checking Right to Work documents and any visa/work restrictions
- Processing and monitoring DBS checks
- Obtaining and verifying employment references
- Checking mandatory training certificates and expiry dates
- Checking identification and recruitment documentation
- Monitoring compliance and chasing outstanding or expiring documents
- Maintaining accurate candidate records on company systems
- Carrying out regular compliance checks and file audits
- Supporting the recruitment team with candidate administration
- Communicating professionally with candidates, workers and clients
- General recruitment and office administration duties

About You

You should have:
- Previous recruitment administration or compliance experience
- A good understanding of recruitment compliance
- Excellent attention to detail
- Strong organisational and administrative skills
- Confidence in chasing candidates for outstanding documentation
- Good telephone and email communication skills
- The ability to manage multiple candidates and priorities
- Good IT skills
- A professional and reliable approach to work

Experience within a healthcare recruitment agency would be a strong advantage.

Compliance is an essential part of this position. You must understand the importance of ensuring workers are appropriately vetted and fully compliant before they are supplied to healthcare clients.

About Us

Brookes HC Recruitment Ltd supplies temporary and permanent healthcare professionals to organisations across the UK.

We are looking for someone who can become an important part of our recruitment team and help us maintain high standards of recruitment, compliance and candidate care.

Job Type: Full-time

If you have recruitment administration experience and a strong understanding of compliance, we would like to hear from you.
